entries.02e19c17709783e5: A machine tool maker that manufactures and sells precision machine tools, centered on automatic lathes, with about 8 tenths of its sales accounted for by the China business.
entries.107c62c1e0a2fcec: A business model in which automatic lathes, grinding machines and other machine tools are manufactured at plants in Japan, China and India and sold to manufacturing customers through sales subsidiaries around the world.
entries.1871dc2e56d422ae: In India, a subsidiary in Chennai manufactures and sells machine tools. In December 2025, a new factory of the subsidiary was completed. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,819 million.
entries.1af4d5408a5831c4: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it is working on three priority issues. First, “accelerating global growth and optimizing the product portfolio,” which lists concentrating resources in growth markets and strengthening investment in high value-added areas, such as automotive parts that require environmental compliance and energy-saving performance, and IT and medical fields where sophistication is advancing. The second is “productivity and supply chain efficiency,” and the third is “product development contributing to solving social issues,” including development of next-generation machine tools for automation and labor saving. Its basic management policy is to anticipate market needs on the foundation of the precision technology cultivated since its founding and to contribute to society through the creation of new value.
entries.237fb3aaa847c49d: In China, subsidiaries in Zhejiang and Anhui Provinces manufacture and sell machine tools such as automatic lathes and castings for machine tools. Sales revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,476 million, the largest business, accounting for about 8 tenths of consolidated sales revenue.
